comment: Independent steal.c witness: a dwarf Valkyrie wears a cloak of displacement, wakes a summoned mountain nymph with a tin whistle and drops everything else, then keeps attacking the wall. When the nymph charms the cloak off her, remove_worn_item() runs Cloak_off(), whose toggle_displacement() message says monsters no longer have difficulty pinpointing her. The port plans each monster move before playing it; that planning pass must not print the cloak message on the live screen, where it added an extra --More-- after the wall message.
